第25章 我会对你负责的（第1页）
银甲女子冷冷的看着苏辰，目光中涌现杀意。
苏辰咕噜的咽了口唾沫，连忙道：“这不怪我，我尝试反抗了，但……”
银甲女子面色一寒，狠狠呵斥一声，心中更是羞怒万分。
她现在恢复了意识，自然也清楚，是自己强行把对方压倒在了身下！
而之后，她体内的淫毒虽然化解，却也没有抵挡住那特殊的感觉和突破武王的诱惑……
而这，更让一向高冷的她难以接受。
“你我之间，什么都没有发生过，明白吗？”
苏辰连忙点头，但发现自己身体此时一丝不挂。
当即，苏辰从纳戒之中取出一身衣服，快速的穿在身上。
但因为之下脚步无力，脚下一个不稳，瘫倒在地上。
而银甲女子脸上不禁是闪过了一丝羞怒之色。
她的身体，也同样火辣辣的疼痛，可见刚才的“战斗”
“前辈放心，这件事情我保证不跟任何人提起，天知地知，你知我知。”
银甲女子颔首，“这次，你毕竟是帮了我，还帮我……嗯，再加上我本身天资卓绝，经过了这次受伤之后，破而后立，凭借自己的能力突破到了武王境界，因此，我才会留下你的性命。”
虽然清楚应该是自己的元力帮助银甲女子突破，但苏辰现在又如何敢说一声“不”
虽然自己没一点错误，可毕竟弱小，若是这银甲女子想取自己的性命，实在太过容易，而且也不会有任何代价。
银甲女子沉吟片刻，忽然手指一抬，顿时，大量的物品从她食指纳戒之中飞了出来，如同小山一般。

苏辰打眼一扫，发现这堆东西中有武技、功法、丹药，还有一些其它东西，都是级别较低武者修炼能用得到的。
“这些东西，对我来说没有什么用处，不过对你来说应该算是重要的宝物，我把它们赐给你，应该对你的修炼道路有所帮助。”
苏辰惊喜万分，将那一堆东西收入纳戒中，但旋即他想到什么，微微一怔。
在这个时候对方给了自己这些东西，怎么想都觉得有些怪异，仿佛是……
“算了，不管这些了，有宝物不拿白不拿，就当是我损失处男之身的补偿了。”
银甲女子道：“我要走了，你不要妄图找我，你我之间本不会有什么关联，我是武王，而你不过区区武徒，身份有别，希望你好自为之！”
但不知怎的，他对这个夺走了自己初夜的女子，还是有特殊的情感在，听到对方这般冰冷的话语，心中也是十分失落。
但旋即，苏辰忽然不知道从哪里来的勇气，猛地抬起头：“若有一天，我修炼到了武王境界，一定会对你负责的。”
一股凛然的杀意，从银甲女子身上爆发出来，将苏辰笼罩。

Chapter 25 I will be responsible for you (Page 1)
The silver-armored woman looked at Su Chen coldly, with murderous intent in her eyes.
Su Chen swallowed hard and said quickly: "It's not my fault. I tried to resist, but..."
The silver-armored woman's face turned cold, and she scolded her harshly, feeling extremely ashamed and angry in her heart.
Now that she has regained consciousness, she naturally understands that it was she who forced the other party down under her!
After that, although the poison in her body was resolved, she could not resist the special feeling and the temptation to break through King Wu...
And this was even more difficult for her, who had always been aloof, to accept.
"Nothing has ever happened between you and me, do you understand?"
Su Chen nodded quickly, but found that his body was naked at this time.
Immediately, Su Chen took out a set of clothes from Najie and quickly put them on.
But because his steps were weak, his feet were unstable and he collapsed to the ground.
The silver-armored woman couldn't help but have a look of shame and anger flash across her face.
Her body was also in burning pain, which could be seen from the "battle" just now.
"Senior, don't worry. I promise not to mention this matter to anyone. God knows and the earth knows. You know and I know."
The woman in silver armor nodded, "This time, after all, you helped me, and you also helped me... Well, plus I am extremely talented. After this injury, I stood up again and broke through to the Martial King realm with my own ability. Therefore, I will keep your life."
Although he knew that it was his Yuan Power that should help the woman in silver armor break through, how could Su Chen dare to say "no" now?
Although she made no mistakes, she was weak after all. If this woman in silver armor wanted to take her own life, it would be too easy, and there would be no price.
The silver-armored woman pondered for a moment, then suddenly raised her finger, and immediately, a large number of items flew out from the ring on her index finger, like a small mountain.
Su Chen took a quick look and found that there were martial arts, exercises, elixirs, and other things in this pile that could be used by lower-level warriors.
"These things are of little use to me, but they should be considered important treasures to you. I give them to you, and they should be helpful to your cultivation path."
Su Chen was extremely surprised and put the pile of things into the ring, but then he thought of something and was slightly startled.
At this time, the other party gave me these things. No matter how you think about it, it feels a little weird, as if...
"Forget it, forget about it. If you don't take the treasure, it will be for nothing. Just consider it as compensation for the loss of my virginity."
The woman in silver armor said: "I'm leaving. Don't try to find me. There is no connection between you and me. I am the King of Martial Arts, and you are just a martial arts disciple. We have different identities. I hope you can take care of yourself!"
But somehow, he still had special feelings for the woman who took away his first night. Hearing such cold words from the other party, he felt very disappointed.
But immediately, Su Chen suddenly got the courage from nowhere and raised his head suddenly: "If one day, I reach the realm of King Wu, I will definitely be responsible for you."
An awe-inspiring killing intent burst out from the silver-armored woman and enveloped Su Chen.
